info.dataset: Dataset of 1000 Images of Malicious and Benign QR codes (2025), URLs decoded from QR images
info.experimental_reason: Benign URLs in this set are mostly well-known sites while malicious ones are throw-away domains; the model may learn that sampling artefact rather than general URL maliciousness.
limitations: Shown as an extra hint next to URLs; NOT used in the overall risk fusion.
